reference_notes: i2i ONLY victoria-sheet-front.png (top-left frontal crop). The 12-up victoria-sheet.png is source-only — never upload it to Kie. Do not i2i from victoria.png / alena.png / character-sheet-2k.
png_required_action: Crop top-left frontal from the 12-up into victoria-sheet-front.png. Cover i2i that crop only.

visual_lock.identity: Виктория, таролог команды «ТАРО СЕЙЧАС» — та же женщина, что на кропе victoria-sheet-front.png и в Instagram-каруселях
visual_lock.face_source: ONLY memory/cover/assets/victoria-sheet-front.png — i2i lock. Never upload the 12-up sheet.
visual_lock.studio: high-key studio portrait, clean white #FFFFFF, no beige/cream
visual_lock.hair: straight shoulder-length blonde balayage with middle part; dark ashy-brown / darker roots; warm honey-blonde mid-lengths and ends; not platinum, not ice-blonde

hair_color_lock.prompt: hair color copied exactly from reference photo, same root depth, do not lighten, no platinum
hair_color_lock.look_ru: светлый блонд с тёплым honey/пепельным мясом, корни темнее (тёмный блонд / пепельно-русый)
hair_color_lock.blocker: Platinum / strongly lighter than the reference = rebuild the canvas.

visual_lock.eyes: almond-shaped; green with a slight brown/hazel tint near the pupil — match Instagram carousels and victoria-sheet.png

eye_color_lock.prompt: eyes green with a slight brown/hazel tint, same as reference sheet and Instagram carousels, not brown, not grey, not a different eye color
eye_color_lock.look_ru: зелёные с лёгким карим/hazel у зрачка, как на карусели
forbidden: different eye color than the sheet
eye_color_lock.blocker: Eyes brown/grey/wrong color vs sheet = rebuild the whole 2x2 canvas.

visual_lock.brows: dark blonde / light brown, groomed, natural arch
visual_lock.makeup: muted dusty-rose / mauve lipstick; professional contour; warm tan; no heavy winged liner unless it matches the sheet
visual_lock.jewelry: thin gold chain with circular gold medallion pendant (from sheet). Stud earrings optional.
visual_lock.expression_rule: new natural editorial emotion every cover; never the same stock smile
forbidden_sets: i2i from any face file except victoria-sheet-front.png

outfit_rule: Камисоль + джинсы на sheet — только реф лица, не lock одежды. Одежда и поза каждый раз новые: business-chic / светлая студия. Не белое худи пайплайна. Не кот.
prompt_fragment: FACE LOCK: same woman as this cropped photo victoria-sheet-front.png, oval-to-heart, high cheekbones, green eyes with a slight hazel/light-brown mix, warm honey-wheat blonde with darker roots not platinum, new clothes and new pose (not the sheet white cami + jeans). Host LARGE left; tiny topic prop right; #FFF
cover_hook_rules: cover_hook — 2–6 слов на кадре, не заголовок статьи; Cover-text invents from reader_pain
hook type = editorial display (didone or refined grotesque), letters part of the frame, not a sticker
highlight = one word from hook, same typeface, medallion gold — not pink, not bold condensed
один хук + один мелкий предмет/метафора; host LARGE left; never cat; never faceless

cover_credit_html.note: Подпись НАД картинкой кодом/HTML. Нейросеть эту строку не рисует.

rebuild_rule: Если лицо не Виктории с кропа victoria-sheet-front.png, глаза не зелёные с лёгким hazel, волосы платина/сильно светлее рефа — пересобрать весь холст 2K 2×2. Не чинить лицо снаружи. Hall и Владимир проверяют лицо. Пайплайн не публикует.
